violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Replace torn gasket to reach in cooler.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Drawer cooler/freezer have build up of food debris and need cleaning. Product slicer has dried onions still between blades. Needs cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Cabinets at service area of "Stacked" have debris buildup and need cleaning.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Hand sink at dish ring area not provided with hand towels.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Water damaged ceiling tiles above dish machine.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. Unlabeled chemical spray bottle in dish ring area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not maintained in good repair. - Dry storage room is needing maintenance. There is a crack along the tiled floor where there is an inch gap in some areas. Posses a tripping hazard. - Also, a small leak in the dry storage room along one of the walls. Coming in from piping that goes outside. Not bad now but is more obvious when it rains.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
